# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py from ticket2pr.config.Settings. Do not edit. -->

Every setting is an environment variable with the `T2P_` prefix, or a line in a `.env` file
in the working directory. Lists and mappings are JSON, e.g.
`T2P_REPOS='{"PROJ": "acme/api"}'`. The Claude API key is also accepted under its usual
name, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, in the environment or in `.env`.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `T2P_JIRA_BASE_URL` | *(empty)* | Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net. |
| `T2P_JIRA_EMAIL` | *(empty)* | Account that owns the API token. |
| `T2P_JIRA_API_TOKEN` | *(secret)* | Jira API token. |
| `T2P_JIRA_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | *(secret)* | Shared secret Jira signs webhooks with (required by serve). |
| `T2P_TRIGGER_LABEL` | `ticket2pr` | Only tickets carrying this label are processed. |
| `T2P_GITHUB_TOKEN` | *(secret)* | Fine-grained token: Contents + Pull requests (read/write). |
| `T2P_GITHUB_API_URL` | `https://api.github.com` | Change for GitHub Enterprise Server. |
| `T2P_REPOS` | `{}` | Jira project key → GitHub repo, e.g. {"PROJ": "acme/api"}. |
| `T2P_FORK_OWNER` | *(empty)* | Push branches to <fork_owner>/<repo> (a fork owned by the bot) and open cross-repository PRs. Recommended: a branch pushed to the target repository runs its CI with the repository's secrets before anyone reviews the agent's code. |
| `T2P_BASE_BRANCH` | `main` | Branch to clone and target with PRs. |
| `T2P_BRANCH_PREFIX` | `ticket2pr/` | Prefix of the branches pushed. |
| `T2P_COMMIT_AUTHOR_NAME` | `ticket2pr` | Commit author name. |
| `T2P_COMMIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL` | `ticket2pr@users.noreply.github.com` | Commit author email. Also how re-runs recognise ticket2pr's own commits: a branch whose head has another author email is never overwritten. |
| `T2P_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | *(secret)* | Claude API key (also read without the T2P_ prefix). Empty: the Claude Agent SDK uses its own credentials (environment or `claude` login). |
| `T2P_MODEL` | `claude-opus-5-5` | Claude model the agent runs on. |
| `T2P_EFFORT` | `high` | low, medium, high, xhigh or max. |
| `T2P_MAX_BUDGET_USD` | `5.0` | Hard spend cap per ticket. |
| `T2P_MAX_TURNS` | `80` | Agent turn cap per attempt. |
| `T2P_AGENT_TIMEOUT_S` | `1800` | Wall-clock limit per agent attempt, in seconds. |
| `T2P_SANDBOX` | `true` | Run the agent's Bash and the repository's tests in a bubblewrap sandbox (Linux; needs bwrap and socat). Jobs fail when it cannot start. Disable only when the worker itself runs in an isolated, egress-restricted container. |
| `T2P_TEST_NETWORK` | `false` | Give the sandboxed test run network access (e.g. when the test command installs dependencies, like `uv run pytest`). |
| `T2P_SANDBOX_READONLY_PATHS` | `[]` | Extra toolchain directories under $HOME or the working directory that the test sandbox must still see (read-only). |
| `T2P_NETWORK_ALLOWLIST` | `["pypi.org", "files.pythonhosted.org"]` | Domains the agent's sandboxed Bash may reach (package registries). Each is also a way out for repository data: avoid registries that accept uploads on the same host, such as registry.npmjs.org (npm publish). |
| `T2P_TEST_COMMAND` | *(empty)* | Overrides auto-detection when set. |
| `T2P_TEST_TIMEOUT_S` | `900` | Test run limit, in seconds. |
| `T2P_MAX_CHANGED_FILES` | `25` | Larger changes fail the job instead of opening a PR. |
| `T2P_PROTECTED_PATHS` | `[".github/", ".git/", "**/.env", "**/*.pem", "**/*.key"]` | Glob patterns the agent may neither edit nor commit. |
| `T2P_DRAFT_ON_TEST_FAILURE` | `true` | Open PRs as drafts when the tests fail or are missing. |
| `T2P_DATA_DIR` | `.ticket2pr` | Job database and workspaces live here. |
| `T2P_API_TOKEN` | *(secret)* | Bearer token for the /jobs API; empty disables it. |
| `T2P_WORKERS` | `2` | Concurrent jobs in serve mode. Forced to 1 when the sandbox is disabled. |
